product: DarkMoon Community — Terminal Explorer (OpenCode TUI plugin, read-only)
binary: opencode-darkmoon 1.19.6, model providers disabled (no model call possible during capture)
data_source_detail: Demo seed: an anonymised copy of a lab campaign against DVGA (Damn Vulnerable GraphQL Application, a public intentionally vulnerable app) plus synthetic overlays (treatment statuses, owners, due dates, profile) labelled SYNTHETIC DEMO DATA in the data itself. No customer data.
capture_method: tmux capture-pane -> ANSI -> HTML grid -> PNG (Playwright, DejaVu Sans Mono)
compression: palette-quantised to 128 colours (no dithering) with Pillow; pngquant/optipng were not available
privacy_review: checked visually 2026-11-20: no lab hostname, IP, credential or personal name visible
description: Legend dialog: the shared vocabulary for Evidence-Backed vs Possible Attack Path, evidence status (exploited / confirmed / to confirm) and treatment marks. Note: the Evidence-Backed wording overstates the code for R3 steps; see docs/limitations.
